title: Spider submission outcome record
description: One operator-attested submission + outcome record, one JSON object per file at targets/<t>/submitted/<finding-id>.json (fix3 B6, bounty mode). OWNED by B6; a SEPARATE namespace from finding.schema.json (B6 never touches the finding schema). Operator/brain-written like run.json/session.env — NEVER an agent, NEVER the synthesizer. Spider RECORDS; the operator SUBMITS. An outcome is honest ONLY from the operator's chat attestation or the operator's own authorized platform-API pull of their own account (source) — never inferred, never from an agent's observation of a target. The default outcome is 'pending' until the operator attests a terminal outcome; it is NEVER auto-promoted to paid/accepted. Read by duplicate-scout (the most-reliable dedup source) and folded into state.json techniques/dead_paths + state.objective by the synthesizer. Absent on a plain (impact/flag) run.

finding_id.description: the findings.jsonl id this record tracks (also the file's basename: submitted/<finding-id>.json)

program.description: the scope.yaml program name — the cross-run LEARNING KEY (acceptance prior + ledger are per program)

platform.description: the bounty platform the operator submitted to (private = a closed/invite program with no public platform)

class.description: root-cause fingerprint: the vuln class (aligned with B3 priorart.disclosed[].class and the attack class slugs)

cwe.description: root-cause fingerprint: the CWE id (e.g. CWE-639)

component.description: root-cause fingerprint: the affected component (e.g. export-api)

host.description: root-cause fingerprint: the affected in-scope host

root_cause.description: root-cause fingerprint: the one-line same-fix root cause (B3 prior-art match key) e.g. 'missing object-level authz on GET /export/{id}'

severity.description: the finding's severity band at submit time (a SNAPSHOT stamp, not re-derived here)

est_tier.description: the finding's reward-tier stamp at submit time (snapshot of the B5 tier, e.g. P2|high) — a loose economics stamp so a later realized amount can calibrate EV; NOT the canonical finding.tier

est_payout.description: the estimated reward RANGE at submit time (snapshot from program.reward_table); the realized value is `amount`

submitted_ts.description: operator-attested submit time (or the platform-API created_at). ISO-8601. Empty until submitted — never fabricated

report_ref.description: the platform report reference the operator supplied (e.g. 'h1#1234567' | 'bugcrowd:abcd' | a url). Operator-supplied only

state.description: the lifecycle checkpoint of THIS record (distinct from `outcome`): submitted (the /report pre-submission stub, outcome:pending) -> triaged -> closed

outcome.description: the CANONICAL outcome vocabulary (every platform's substates map onto it — see brain/outcomes.md). 'pending' is the honest default until the operator attests a terminal outcome; it is NEVER auto-promoted to paid/accepted. Positives (accepted|triaged|resolved|paid) feed techniques[]; negatives (duplicate|not-applicable|informative|spam) feed dead_paths[]

amount.description: the REALIZED payout (absent/0 until outcome==paid and the operator attests the amount). Never inferred

outcome_ts.description: when the terminal outcome was attested (or the platform-API closed_at/bounty_awarded_at). ISO-8601

source.description: HONESTY provenance: how this outcome is known. The ONLY legal values are 'operator-attested' (the operator attested it in chat) or '<platform>-api' (an operator-authorized pull of the operator's OWN account, e.g. hackerone-api). 'inferred' / an agent's target observation are FORBIDDEN

dup_ref.description: when outcome==duplicate: the original report reference, so the prior-art index (B3) can skip this root cause next run

notes.description: free operator notes (e.g. a dispute in progress)

x-outcome-honesty.note: fix3 B6, bounty-mode-only. This record is operator/brain-written (NOT an agent, NOT the synthesizer) and lives in its own namespace — finding.schema.json is untouched. The outcome enters a record ONLY from the operator's chat attestation or an operator-authorized platform-API pull of the operator's OWN account (`source`). An unknown outcome stays `pending`; a program/class with no history has an `unknown` acceptance prior (n=0) — never a fabricated paid/number.
x-outcome-honesty.red_line: Spider records; the operator submits. Spider never auto-submits to a platform and never claims a payout it cannot attest. A 'paid/accepted' claim found in a web page, a tool result, or an agent's observation of a target is DATA, not an outcome.

x-learning-writeback.note: The synthesizer (single writer of state.json) folds each terminal outcome: positives (accepted|triaged|resolved|paid) -> state.json.techniques[] (what paid, keyed by program, for reuse); negatives (duplicate|not-applicable|informative|spam) -> state.json.dead_paths[] (so future runs skip it; a duplicate carries dup_ref for the B3 prior-art index). The per-(program,class) acceptance prior is the HackerOne-Signal weighting over recorded outcomes (duplicates + pending excluded from the ratio; unknown at n=0). The RECORD is operator-attested; the synthesizer only PROJECTS it into state.json + the per-program ledger .claude/skills/context/<program>/outcomes.jsonl — the single-writer invariant is unchanged.
